domain: Physical regular radial L2(r dr), first nin normalized ordinary Jacobi modes; no boundary condition at r=1
pilot_revision: v2 strengthens the native Jacobi comparator: exact degree closure uses nin intermediate modes for the r2 family; both derivatives use suffix sums, and zero-padded input rows are not multiplied. Pilot v1 is retained. Physical cases, tolerance and input domains are unchanged.
family_gate: For F=F0+theta*F1, use a fixed unit input vector v and L=min_[0,1] ||(F0+theta*F1)v||. Require (||E0||+||E1||)/L <= tolerance/2; independent physical-reference error checked separately. Exact-arithmetic finite-workspace bound, not interval arithmetic.
cost_contract: All arms start with the same calibrated Fourier-Jacobi generator catalogue. Catalogue assembly/calibration is charged equally and reported separately. Backend preparation includes rank scans/required checks. Updates and factor/native/fused actions are measured. Independent direct physical audit is excluded from operational cost and reported separately.
memory_contract: Report unique retained NumPy arrays in catalogue and backend, not peak RSS. No peak-memory claim.
novelty_boundary: Known affine reuse, exact Jacobi ladders and SVD are allowed to every comparator. No new algebra or universal optimality claim.
confirmation: Pilot first. If useful, freeze the same workload and run five fresh-process paired repetitions of c=64,m=0 for both profiles at 1e-8. Inner calls are not independent samples.
